presentation.headline: From ad click to checkout.
presentation.intro: We reviewed your public ads and product pages. Start with the ad link and the Primer + Bonder idea, then see how RISE would assess the growth opportunity.

route.headline: Show the colours. Let shoppers choose.
route.body: Your ad advertises all fiber-gel colours. Its recorded link opens Fiber Gel OSCAR. A collection link would let shoppers browse the range.
route.action: Try the same ad with a link to the gel collection.
route.ad_quote: Swatchar alla yananails fiber gel färger

pair.headline: Make the pair easy to add.
pair.body: Your Primer and Bonder pages say the two products are used together. Offer both from the Primer page so shoppers can add the pair in one step.

guidance.headline: Bring the buying advice up front.
guidance.body: Your replies to RYAN reviews explain lamp heat and flash curing. Put a short version of your existing handling guidance beside Add to cart, where shoppers can read it before ordering.

shipping.headline: Make free shipping easier to reach.
shipping.body: Your store offers free shipping above 999 kr in Sweden. Show a relevant add-on when it takes a basket past that amount.

tests.test: Add a Bonder + Primer button to the Primer page, with a short explanation of the two steps. Compare sales with the current page.
tests.title: Offer Bonder with Primer
tests.measure: Sales per visitor to the Primer page. Also check Primer-only orders and returns.
tests.observation: Both pages say the products are used together. The pairing appears in their product descriptions.

tests.test: Place a short handling note beside Add to cart, using your existing guidance. Compare purchases with the current page.
tests.title: Bring RYAN’s handling advice closer to the buy button
tests.measure: Purchases per RYAN page visitor. Also check returns and comments about lamp heat.
tests.observation: Your replies to RYAN reviews explain lamp heat and flash curing. That advice could be easier to find before ordering.

tests.test: Run the same ad with a link to the gel collection. Compare it with the OSCAR-page link using the same audience and budget.
tests.title: Send the colour-swatch ad to the gel collection
tests.measure: Sales per ad click. Also check order value and returns.

quality.delivery_summary: One issue the public pages show: No subscribe or refill option on Builder Gel PHILIP. The scan includes the evidence and a proposed fix. Actual impact needs your numbers.

drop_off.note: Nothing on your public pages stood out as a place shoppers stall before checkout. Your checkout and analytics aren't public, so that's the first thing Mattan opens on a call.

second_order.note: Your repeat-order rate isn't public, so we read what your store gives a first-time buyer to come back for.

items.fix: Test a subscribe-and-save option on Builder Gel PHILIP, with a small discount on each repeat delivery.
items.title: No subscribe or refill option on Builder Gel PHILIP
items.detail: Builder Gel PHILIP is something a customer uses up, but its page only sells one-time orders, so the next order depends on them remembering to come back.

evidence.label: Subscribe option on the replenishable products checked
evidence.value: None on these 2 replenishable product records: Builder Gel PHILIP; Nagellim

review.reason: All five proposals are tied to this store's own products, pages and ads: Bonder with Primer, RYAN handling advice, the OSCAR-linked swatch ad, the 999 kr free-shipping threshold, and a PHILIP refill option. Each test names a change and a shared downstream outcome. Claims are supported by the quoted store, ad and catalog evidence, and the subscription finding is scoped to the product records actually read. No contradictions or unsupported behaviour found.
